blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: de past perfect vormen met had + voltooid deelwoord
duidelijk maken welke gebeurtenis eerst kwam
by the time, already, before en after gebruiken
de past perfect continuous herkennen (had been waiting)

blocks.label: onregelmatig werkwoord
examples: I had already left when she called.
Ik was al weg toen ze belde.
You had left your keys at home.
Je had je sleutels thuis laten liggen.
The train had left by the time we arrived.
De trein was al vertrokken toen we aankwamen.
We had left before the rain started.
We waren vertrokken voordat de regen begon.
You had left the door open.
Jullie hadden de deur open laten staan.

blocks.text: De past perfect is altijd had, voor alle personen. De korte vorm is 'd: I'd seen, she'd gone. De ontkenning is hadn't.
Je vertelt over het verleden in de past simple. Wil je laten zien dat iets daarvoor al gebeurd was, dan gebruik je de past perfect.

head: Engels
Volgorde
rows: When I arrived, the film had started.
eerst begon de film, toen kwam ik
When I arrived, the film started.
ik kwam, en toen begon de film
She was nervous because she had never flown before.
nog nooit gevlogen vóór dat moment
I didn't recognise him. He had grown a beard.
de baard was er al

blocks.title: Bijna als in het Nederlands
blocks.text: Het Nederlands heeft dezelfde tijd: Ik had hem al gezien. Alleen gebruikt het Engels altijd had, ook waar het Nederlands was zegt: Hij was al vertrokken = He had already left.

blocks.title: Niet nodig als de volgorde al duidelijk is
blocks.text: Na after of before is de volgorde al duidelijk, dus de past simple mag ook: After she finished (of had finished) her work, she went home.

Met had been + -ing zeg je hoe lang iets al bezig was vóór een moment in het verleden: When the bus finally came, we had been waiting for an hour. (We stonden al een uur te wachten.) She was tired because she had been working all day.

rows: When we arrived, the train has left.
When we arrived, the train had left.
Vóór een moment in het verleden: had.
He was already gone home.
He had already gone home.
De past perfect gaat altijd met had.
I didn't know her because I never met her before.
I didn't know her because I had never met her before.
Eerder dan dat moment: past perfect.
She had went to bed.
She had gone to bed.
Na had komt het voltooid deelwoord.
We were waiting for an hour when the bus came.
We had been waiting for an hour when the bus came.
Hoe lang al bezig: had been + -ing.

blocks.text: Vul de past simple of de past perfect in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: When I got to the station, the train ______.
items.full: When I got to the station, the train had left.

items.q: She ______ never seen snow before she moved to Canada.
items.full: She had never seen snow before she moved to Canada.

items.q: I didn't recognise him. He ______ a lot.
items.full: I didn't recognise him. He had changed a lot.

items.q: By the time we arrived, the party ______.
items.full: By the time we arrived, the party had finished.

items.q: They ______ tired because they had walked all day.
items.full: They were tired because they had walked all day.

items.q: We ______ eaten, so we weren't hungry.
items.full: We had already eaten, so we weren't hungry.

items.q: He couldn't pay because he ______ his wallet.
items.full: He couldn't pay because he had lost his wallet.

items.q: We had ______ waiting for two hours when the doctor called us.
items.full: We had been waiting for two hours when the doctor called us.

items.q: I ______ seen the film, so I didn't go.
items.full: I had seen the film, so I didn't go.

items.q: She told me she ______ in Spain before.
items.full: She told me she had never lived in Spain before.

items.q: Toen ik aankwam, was de film al begonnen.
items.a: When I arrived, the film had already started.

items.q: Hij was al naar huis gegaan.
Ik had haar nog nooit eerder gezien.
items.a: I had never seen her before.

items.q: We stonden al een uur te wachten.
items.a: We had been waiting for an hour.
